scripts.lint: oxlint && node scripts/check-brand.mjs && node scripts/check-grid-spans.mjs && node scripts/check-theme-colors.mjs
scripts.screenshots: docker run --rm --network host -v "$PWD":/w -w /w mcr.microsoft.com/playwright/python:v1.55.0-noble bash -c "pip install -q playwright==1.55.0 && python scripts/screenshot-pages.py"
scripts.audit:dark: docker run --rm --network host -v "$PWD":/w -w /w mcr.microsoft.com/playwright/python:v1.55.0-noble bash -c 'pip install -q playwright==1.55.0 && python scripts/dark-theme-audit.py "$@"' audit
scripts.e2e:image: docker rm -f vmss-e2e-build >/dev/null 2>&1; docker run --name vmss-e2e-build mcr.microsoft.com/playwright/python:v1.55.0-noble pip install -q playwright==1.55.0 pytest==8.4.2 pytest-playwright==0.7.1 && docker commit vmss-e2e-build vmss-e2e:local && docker rm vmss-e2e-build
scripts.e2e: docker run --rm --network host --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -e PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 -v "$PWD":/w -v "${E2E_TOKENS_DIR:-$PWD/../VMSS_API/var/qa}":/tokens:ro -w /w/e2e vmss-e2e:local python -m pytest
